text:
anita: Quick alert — some embeddings requests are being routed to the small model and then rejected with 413 when payloads exceed 512KB, even though client requested redwood-embed-large. console shows routing_hint='tier_affinity' but no quota tag.
rob: do we have a repro request id? curious if this is preflight mis-evaluating capacity vs runtime check.
dan: reproducible sample: header X-Embed-Meta: tier=enterprise;prefer_low_latency=true and body ~600KB array of 512-dim vectors. Preflight returned 200 but runtime returned 413.
claire: that sounds like preflight is calculating size by token/entries while runtime uses actual bytes after JSON encoding + compression differences. mismatch leads to silent split or reject.
anita: exact curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \\ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ 
  -H 'X-Embed-Meta: tier=enterprise;client_id=acct_99' \\ 
  -d '{"input": [ ... large array ... ], "model": "redwood-embed-large"}'
```
rob: our preflight estimator uses dimensions*4 bytes as heuristic. JSON overhead and base64-ish payload pushes it over. two problems: estimator accuracy and routing/quotas not annotated with estimator_version.
dan: suggestion: attach preflight_estimate and estimator_version to the request metadata emitted to runtime and console. that way we can trace where approximation diverged. also emit preflight_hash so ingress->runtime->console traces can be joined.
claire: agree. also we should expose a soft-fail fastpath: if preflight says OK but runtime predicts 413, runtime can try a best-effort split into two batches (if multi-input) and return partial results with warning header X-Embed-Partial: true. customers can opt-in via header 'X-Embed-Client-Behavior: allow_split'.
anita: caution: partial responses complicate SDK semantics. but for bulk ingestion jobs this could improve throughput. we need product to weigh in.
rob: for immediate triage: add telemetry metric preflight_vs_runtime_size_mismatch{env,model}. create dashboard tile showing mismatch rate and mean delta bytes. alert if mismatch_rate > 0.2% AND >500/day.
dan: will add metric. also propose console show estimated_size and runtime_size for sampled requests (1% sampling) and a link to raw request trace. hashed client_id only.
lisa: (joining) product here — splitting by default could surprise users. prefer to return explicit 413 with explanatory error code embed_oversize_estimate_diff and suggest SDK-side client-side chunking guidance. allow_split should be opt-in.
claire: fair. then runtime should log both sizes and emit embed_oversize_estimate_diff telemetry. we can iterate on improving estimator.
rob: immediate code change: 1) annotate preflight payloads with estimator_version v0.3, preflight_estimate_bytes; 2) add telemetry counter mismatch_delta_bytes bucketed; 3) console sampling of full sizes at 1% with hashed client_id. will ship as canary.
anita: also add an ingress frontend check to normalize X-Embed-Meta -> X-Client-Meta (we have multiple SDKs using different keys). normalizing reduces routing surprises.
dan: infra-bot: deploy 1715006030 by rob: preflight annotate + telemetry counters -> staging
infra-bot: deploy 1715006030 by rob: success -> staging
claire: after staging smoke, let's run 2-hour prod canary with sampling bumped to 5% for size trace and retain traces 14 days for debug. must add privacy note: hashed client_id only, no client metadata retained.
rob: will add feature-flag 'embed_preflight_v0_3' gated to 20% traffic during canary. also adding dashboard /dashboards/embed-size-mismatch and alert rule.
dan: on error side, update API error schema to include fields: code, message, estimate_bytes, runtime_bytes, request_id. that helps SDKs surface actionable guidance.
lisa: yes update SDKs: provide helper to chunk inputs based on recommended max_payload_bytes. add changelog note.
anita: followups assigned: rob (deploy + dashboards), dan (tracing + error schema), claire (SDK product coordination), lisa (customer comms + SDK release).
rob: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/12421 4 additions: estimator v0.3, telemetry, error schema.
infra-bot: deploy 1715006075 by rob: preflight_v0_3 -> prod-canary
anita: monitoring canary now. will post anomalies.
dan: I'll instrument percent_mismatch and mean_delta on the console and add drilldown to traces.
claire: small UX ask: console should show 'estimated' vs 'actual' size columns and a tooltip explaining differences. keep hashed client_id truncated to 8 chars.
rob: agreed. shipping that in console patch.
infra-bot: deploy 1715006089 by rob: console-size-columns -> prod-canary
anita: thanks team, will report back if we see embed_oversize_estimate_diff spikes.
